method: Local full-history clone; exact SHA ancestry and PR-head association. Squash, rebase and unique source history are retained unless separately reconciled.
deletion_status: No branch-deletion capability in the connected GitHub tool set; no authenticated git push is available. Candidates are recorded, not reported deleted.
